scripts.backup: DB=$(grep -m1 '^DATABASE_URL=' .env | cut -d= -f2- | sed 's/^sqlite://'); [ -f "$DB" ] && sqlite3 "$DB" ".backup 'rss-$(($(ls rss-[0-9]*.rss 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*rss-\([0-9]*\)\.rss/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1) + 1)).rss'" || true
scripts.build:all: npm run backup && npm run build && cargo build --release
scripts.build:all:force: npm run backup && npm run build && cargo clean -p rustrsssrv && cargo build --release
